description: This file defines Express.js routes for card-related API endpoints, including fetching user cards, retrieving a single card, changing PIN, and changing limits.

methods.name: getMyCards
methods.description: Handles retrieving the list of cards associated with the current user.

methods.name: getSingle
methods.description: Handles retrieving details of a single card by ID.

methods.name: changePin
methods.description: Handles changing the PIN for a specific card.

methods.name: changeLimits
methods.description: Handles changing the limits for a specific card.
